courses.name: A1 Grammar: Spot the Error with Pham Linh Chi
courses.description: Error detection and correction practice for essential A1 articles and demonstratives.

topics.name: Spot the Error: A and An
topics.description: Choose a or an before familiar singular count nouns.

lessons.title: Articles: A or An?
lessons.description: Find and correct simple article errors with familiar singular nouns.
lessons.content: Use a before a consonant sound: a book, a teacher. Use an before a vowel sound: an apple, an umbrella. Use an article with one singular count noun.

questions.questionText: Find the error: She has a apple.
questions.explanation: Apple begins with a vowel sound, so use an: She has an apple.
questions.knowledgePoint: a and an with singular nouns

questions.questionText: Choose the correction: I see an dog.
questions.explanation: Dog begins with a consonant sound, so use a: I see a dog.
questions.knowledgePoint: a and an with consonant sounds

questions.explanation: Use an before umbrella because it starts with a vowel sound.

questions.questionText: Find the error: They buy an book.
questions.explanation: Book begins with a consonant sound, so use a: They buy a book.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence about one orange.
questions.explanation: Orange begins with a vowel sound, so the singular noun takes an.

topics.name: Spot the Error: This and These
topics.description: Match this and these with singular and plural nouns.

lessons.title: Demonstratives: This or These?
lessons.description: Find and correct agreement errors with this, these, and nearby objects.
lessons.content: Use this with one thing: this pen. Use these with more than one thing: these pens. The noun after this is singular, and the noun after these is plural.

questions.questionText: Find the error: This shoes are new.
questions.explanation: Shoes is plural, so use these: These shoes are new.

questions.questionText: Choose the correction: These pencil is red.
questions.explanation: Pencil is one singular item, so use this and is: This pencil is red.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is correct for two books?
questions.explanation: Two books is plural, so use these and are.

questions.questionText: Find the error: These chair is near the door.
questions.explanation: One chair is singular, so use this and is: This chair is near the door.
questions.correctAnswer: This chair is near the door.

options.text: This chair is near the door.
These chairs are near the door.
This chair are near the door.
These chair is near the door.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence for three keys.
questions.explanation: Three keys is plural, so use these and are.
